title: TAP – Tournament Manager
description: A tournament platform for esports communities: groups, Swiss, double elimination and leagues with promotion and relegation, server-refereed map veto, check-in and live scoring. Comes with a player app for web and mobile, an offline-capable scorer tool, a caster overlay and a Discord bot.

title: N-Body Problem Simulation
description: A numerical simulation of the solar system — planets, moons and Pluto — using the Velocity Verlet integrator. The core runs in C with OpenMP, and a Three.js web viewer lets you fly through 270+ years of orbits, focus any body and export videos.

title: Print Center
description: A CUPS-backed print center for Linux: print any file, manage the queue with live progress, administer printers, scan via SANE and track supply levels. Runs as a small local web app with zero Python dependencies.

title: Open DnD
description: An offline-first D&D 5e character manager for the desktop. Step-by-step character builder, live character sheet, spellbook and inventory with the PHB catalog — everything stored locally in SQLite, no account needed.

title: McLookup
description: A small utility library for Looking up Minecraft Character Data in Kotlin

title: JDA Command Manager
description: A minimal, fast Command Manager for the Discord API - JDA.
